title_zh: 三个代表节点90天实施就绪矩阵
title_en: 90-day implementation-readiness matrix for three representative nodes
purpose_zh: 把概念节点转译为可审核的小试任务书，明确责任角色、资源级别、规划成本区间、时段与容量假设、基线、验收、停止、回滚和依赖；不虚构运营主体、采购报价、场地同意或实施授权。
purpose_en: Translate concept nodes into auditable pilot briefs with role ownership, resource class, planning cost bands, service and capacity assumptions, baselines, acceptance, stop/rollback rules, and dependencies, without inventing operators, quotations, site consent, or implementation authorization.

currency_and_price_basis.included_zh: 临时设计、可移动构件或设备租赁、安装拆除、测试、专业复核、基础运维、保险与预备费的概念性合计。
currency_and_price_basis.included_en: Concept allowance for temporary design, movable components or equipment rental, installation and removal, testing, professional review, basic operations, insurance, and contingency.
currency_and_price_basis.excluded_zh: 土地、永久土建、法定审批、管线迁改、永久机电、长期人员编制、税费和任何未核实的场地修复。
currency_and_price_basis.excluded_en: Land, permanent civil works, statutory approvals, utility relocation, permanent MEP, long-term staffing, taxes, and any unverified site remediation.

pilots.name_zh: 北部校准庭：多传感器共置校准
pilots.spatial_scope_zh: 众智园候选既有开放空间中的可围合设备带、公众等候区与独立维护后场；不改变道路、绿地边界或建筑结构。
pilots.spatial_scope_en: A cordonable equipment strip, public waiting area, and separate maintenance back-of-house in a candidate existing open space at Zhongzhiyuan, without changing streets, green boundaries, or building structure.
pilots.cost_driver_zh: 设备租赁与共置、供电网络临设、专业校准、围合与遮荫、运维值守、撤场。
pilots.cost_driver_en: Equipment rental and co-location, temporary power/network, professional calibration, cordon and shade, staffed operations, and removal.

operating_assumption.capacity: up to 3 calibration batches/day and 6 candidate devices/batch

pilots.baseline_zh: 人工复核、纸质校准记录和设备断电撤回流程可独立运行；参考条件未授权时只使用合成故障。
pilots.baseline_en: Staff review, paper calibration records, and power-off withdrawal work independently; synthetic faults only when reference conditions are not authorized.
acceptance_thresholds: 100% inputs have source, authorization, retention, and expiry records
100% exceptions receive named professional review before any internal record is retained
>=95% scheduled batches produce a complete reviewable record; this is a documentation threshold, not an accuracy claim
paper record and emergency power-off drill pass in every weekly review
zero public regulatory, medical, or real-time air-quality claims
stop_or_rollback: missing reference authorization or professional reviewer
loss of safe separation, power, network, fire access, or staffed supervision
privacy, security, or complaint incident not closed within one working day
manual record or safe power-off path unavailable
dependencies: device, network-security, maintenance, and insurance plan

pilots.name_zh: 中部共译客厅：无障碍呼吸驿
pilots.name_en: Central civic-translation room: accessible breathing post
pilots.spatial_scope_zh: AI 原点社区候选既有首层或街角的可移动服务台、遮荫座椅、纸质/语音说明和人工确认点；不封闭既有通行。
pilots.spatial_scope_en: A movable service desk, shaded seating, paper/voice information, and staffed confirmation point in a candidate existing ground floor or street corner at the AI Origin Community, without closing existing passage.
pilots.cost_driver_zh: 无障碍现场审查、可移动构件、纸质/语音内容、人工值守、更新维护与撤场。
pilots.cost_driver_en: Accessibility audit, movable elements, paper/voice content, staffing, update maintenance, and removal.

operating_assumption.staffed_windows: two 2-hour windows/day during the controlled pilot
operating_assumption.capacity: up to 20 assisted interactions per staffed window

pilots.baseline_zh: 纸质地图、语音协助和工作人员确认持续可用，任何数字界面关闭后仍能完成同一基本服务。
pilots.baseline_en: Paper maps, voice assistance, and staff confirmation remain available; the same basic service still works when every digital interface is switched off.
acceptance_thresholds: 100% displayed facilities have verification date, responsible contact, and expiry/update state
100% staffed windows retain a paper, voice, and human-equivalent path
zero unresolved critical access or safety issue in the displayed inventory
verified change or critical correction reflected within one working day
all complaints acknowledged within one staffed window and triaged within one working day
stop_or_rollback: critical route condition is unknown or changes without update
paper, voice, or staffed equivalent becomes unavailable
unsafe queue, obstruction, glare, weather, or fire-access conflict
privacy or accessibility complaint remains unresolved
host opening, property consent, or maintenance responsibility lapses
dependencies: verified facility inventory and update owner
staffing, weather, cleaning, power, and complaint arrangements

pilots.name_zh: 南部转化前场：室内外终端可用性实验
pilots.name_en: South adoption forecourt: indoor/outdoor terminal usability
pilots.spatial_scope_zh: 大钟寺候选既有综合体首层或交通前场中的人工主持区、纸质任务区、可关闭终端和无障碍等候位；不虚构地下站或新建综合体。
pilots.spatial_scope_en: A staffed facilitation zone, paper-task area, switchable terminals, and accessible waiting positions in a candidate existing ground floor or mobility forecourt at Dazhongsi, without inventing an underground station or new megacomplex.
pilots.cost_driver_zh: 可关闭终端、无障碍交互设计、主持和值守、匿名记录、隐私安全审查、测试保险和撤场。
pilots.cost_driver_en: Switchable terminals, accessible interaction design, facilitation and staffing, anonymous records, privacy/security review, test insurance, and removal.

operating_assumption.capacity: up to 8 voluntary participants/day and 30 minutes/participant

pilots.baseline_zh: 人工主持、纸质任务和语音协助可独立完成同一任务；不采人脸、声纹、身份画像或连续轨迹。
pilots.baseline_en: Staff facilitation, paper tasks, and voice assistance complete the same task independently; no face, voiceprint, identity profile, or continuous trace is collected.
acceptance_thresholds: 100% sessions show consent, exit, deletion, staffed assistance, and incident routes before participation
100% records are anonymous task records with retention and deletion timestamps
>=80% pilot-task completion across each tested access mode, reported with sample size and without population inference
zero dark-pattern, biometric, identity-profile, or forced-scan behavior
all critical accessibility, privacy, or safety issues trigger immediate pause until reviewed
stop_or_rollback: consent, deletion, or staffed fallback fails
sample bias is hidden or results are generalized beyond the pilot
device, network, weather, queue, glare, or accessibility condition becomes unsafe
property, fire, network, or staffing permission lapses
dependencies: accessibility, fire, power, network, and weather plan
staffing, informed participation, deletion, complaint, and insurance protocol

portfolio_gate.release_rule_zh: 三个节点均不得因文档完整而自动进入现场；任一依赖未闭合时，HumanDecision 必须为 modify、pause、reject、rollback 或 exit。
portfolio_gate.release_rule_en: No node enters the field merely because its documentation is complete; if any dependency is open, HumanDecision must be modify, pause, reject, rollback, or exit.
